title: Delete account
heading: Delete your account and all your data
explanation: Everything you have created in LifeSort will be permanently deleted: finances, meal plans, cycle and symptom data, trips, tasks, CV and attached files.
permanentWarning: Deletion cannot be undone, and we cannot restore your data afterwards. If you want a copy, make a backup first under Settings.
done: Your account and all your data have been deleted.
adminAccountError: This account has admin panel access and cannot be deleted here. Contact an owner.
genericError: The account could not be deleted. Try again, or contact support.
